useCase: Zero-shot and few-shot 検出 of AI生成の content にわたる multiple generator types
mechanism: Encodes the input image using CLIP's ViT-L/14 vision encoder to produce a 768-dimensional 特徴 vector. A trained linear probe classifier then determines whether the semantic 特徴 match パターン typical of AI生成の content. Leverages CLIP's understanding of visual-semantic relationships.
accuracy: 高 - 85-93% にわたる diverse AI generators
name: CLIPベースAI検出
source: Radford et al. (2021) - Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision, ICML
parameters: Backbone: ViT-L/14, Feature dim: 768, Classifier: linear probe, Input size: 224x224, Preprocessing: center crop + normalize
description: Leverages OpenAI CLIP vision-言語モデル を検出するために semantic 不整合 間の image content and expected real-world properties. 使用します コントラストive learning for zero-shot 検出.

references.title: Radford, A. et al. (2021). Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision. ICML.
Ojha, U. et al. (2023). Towards Universal Fake Image Detectors that Generalize Across Generative Models. CVPR.

strengths:
• Excellent generalization にわたる AI generators
• Captures high-level semantic 不整合
• Pre-trained on massive dataset (400M image-text pairs)
• Works well without fine-tuning
limitations:
• Requires significant computational resources
• May not catch low-level pixel アーティファクト
• Performance varies with image 解像度
• Large model size (~900MB)
